spans.s: to be enjoyed or eaten, Yājñ.; Kāv. &c.
to be used or employed, Mn. viii, 144
to be possessed or governed or ruled, MārkP.
to be utilized or exploited, MBh.
to be fed (n. impers. ‘a meal is to be eaten’), MBh.; Hariv.
) one who enjoys or eats, enjoyer, eater, experiencer, feeler, sufferer, MaitrUp.; MBh. &c. (also as fut. of √ 3. भुज्, R.)
a possessor, ruler of a land, king, prince, Inscr.
भोक्तृ—त्व n. the state of being an enjoyer &c., enjoyment, possession, perception, MaitrUp.; Bhag.; BhP.
भोक्तृ—शक्ति f. the faculty of the soul as the enjoyer and possessor of nature, Sarvad.
pl. N. of a people, VP.
